See also: Verser and vèrser

English

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From verse +‎ -er.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (General American) IPA(key): /ˈvɝsɚ/
  • (Received Pronunciation) IPA(key): /ˈvɜːsə/
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɜː(ɹ)sə(ɹ)

Noun

[edit]

verser (plural versers)

  1. A versifier.

Anagrams

[edit]
  • revers, server

Dutch

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio:(file)

Adjective

[edit]

verser

  1. comparative degree of vers

Anagrams

[edit]
  • revers, server

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin versāre (“to turn, twist”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /vɛʁ.se/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Canada (Shawinigan)):(file)
  • Audio (Switzerland (Valais)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)

Verb

[edit]

verser

  1. (transitive) to pour
  2. (transitive) to pay, to put money into a fund
  3. (intransitive, of a vehicle) to overturn (turn over, capsize)
